title: Credit Policy Manual — Tier Placement, Deal Terms and Stipulations
content:
## 1. Tier placement

1.1 An application for Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts is placed in the highest tier whose minimum credit score the applicant's score meets.

## 2. Terms an approval states

2.1 **Amount financed:** between the minimum amount financed and the tier's maximum amount financed, and no higher than the tier's maximum loan-to-value of the vehicle price.

2.2 **Down payment:** at least the larger of the tier's minimum down payment percentage of the vehicle price and its minimum down payment dollars.

2.3 **Term:** one of the tier's terms offered, and no longer than the tier's older-vehicle maximum term when the vehicle's model age reaches the older-vehicle age.

2.4 **APR:** the APR for that term from the tier's APR table.

2.5 **Monthly payment:** within the tier's maximum payment-to-income and debt-to-income ratios, measured on verified income that is at or above the tier's minimum monthly income.

2.6 **Odometer:** a vehicle above the tier's maximum odometer cannot be financed at that tier.

2.7 **Back-end products:** financed service contracts, GAP and maintenance plans together may not exceed the tier's maximum back-end percentage of the vehicle price.

2.8 **Negative equity:** trade-in negative equity included in the amount financed may not exceed the tier's maximum negative equity.

2.9 **Expiry:** the approval expires at the end of the decision date plus the tier's approval validity days.

## 3. Stipulations

3.1 When the tier requires proof of income, proof of residence or references, the approval is written with stipulations open.

3.2 Stipulations are cleared only when every required verification is completed. A borrower's statement that documents were sent does not clear them.

3.3 Stipulations are cleared only on an approval whose status is approved; the system record of the approval's status is the evidence, and the clearing concerns that same approval.

## 4. Points of judgement

| Situation | Outcome under this chapter |
|---|---|
| Tier requires proof of income and proof of residence; only proof of income is verified | stipulations stay open |
| Every required verification is completed on an approval with status approved | stipulations are cleared |
| Borrower says the pay stubs were emailed, nothing is verified | stipulations stay open |
| Approval status is expired or withdrawn | stipulations are not cleared |
| Tier requires none of the three verifications | the approval carries no open stipulations |

Hypothetical: an applicant scoring 705 meets the Tier A minimum (700) but not the Tier A+ minimum (760), so the highest tier whose minimum is met is Tier A.
